scope: Entire owning project chat up to the documentation request; later documentation tokens are excluded.

clock.limitation: Wall/turn/goal clocks include tool waits and can include host standby. They are not CPU time, uninterrupted attention or human person-hours.

dollar_cost_status: Not available: no project invoice, credit debits or applicable Codex rate allocation in the evidence. No API price substituted.
